research_store._locator_note: Project, section and dataset keys are resource IDs, not API credentials. Referenced datasets remain private and require authenticated owner access. No tokens, passwords or service-account JSON belong in this file.

radar._comment: Demand radar seeds: 5-15 topic phrases in the audience's own words (not product names) and the communities where the ideal customer talks. cadence_days governs the paid tier (news, trends, video); the free tier runs daily.

repo._comment: Product-change panel (measure.md 4b). scripts/repo_changes.py lists commits since the last run that touch these globs; a shipped feature, a price change or a removed route is the freshest demand signal the site has. Fill with this repo's real paths.

serp._comment: SERP-feature panel (measure.md 3d). Weekly serp_organic_live_advanced on the top N queries by clicks; serp_features.py records which features appeared and whether the AI Overview cites us.

distribute._comment: Restore the full distribute lane: discovery push, Postiz owned-channel drafts, and one third-party brief. Postiz scheduling/posting uses the user's explicit channel/content authorization; site-shipping autonomy is not blanket social/outreach permission.

cadence._comment: Freshness windows in hours; a panel younger than its window is read from cache. See measure.md section 0. Weekly (168) and monthly (720) panels: competitor delta, SERP features, backlinks new/lost, link opportunities, seasonality, on-site search.

budget._comment: The per-run amount is a routine planning target. Standing authorization from 2026-09-16 permits the operator to choose necessary one-off paid SEO research without another approval, including a justified larger report. Preflight and record estimates and actual spend; reuse fresh data. This does not authorize unrelated subscriptions.

select._comment: Below this rubric score (of a possible 40) the best unblocked candidate loses to measure-only. See references/select.md §7.

bing._comment: Optional. api_key_env names the environment variable holding the Bing Webmaster API key; never store the key itself. The AI Performance report is UI-only — no API. Record Bing as a separate panel, never summed with Google.

_legacy_keys_note: Flat pre-v2 keys are kept for anything that still reads them. The nested blocks above are authoritative. `stack` was a string in v1; its value now lives at stack.kind.

git._comment: Standing authority confirmed 2026-09-16: autonomously select and ship SEO posts, docs, site and analytics updates via PR/merge. Preserve appropriate technical checks and explicit task-level no-merge restrictions; do not ask again for routine SEO decisions.
